steps.name: 01 Settings
steps.goal: Open Settings: tap the Navigation button (top left, labelled Navigation. Computer: ...), then tap Settings in the side menu. Note: a session card whose title begins with Error: is the name of a task someone typed, not an app error, so the screen is not blocked.
steps.done: The Settings screen with the Computer section, a Coding agents row and Subscription and plan

steps.name: 02 Coding agents
steps.done: The native Coding agents screen: a note that the sign-in happens on your Computer, and a list with Claude Code and Codex rows that have Connect buttons
expect: The sign-in happens on your Computer

steps.name: 03 Open Claude sheet
steps.goal: Tap Connect on the Claude Code row
steps.done: A tray titled Sign in to Claude with Step 1 of 2, a two-step rail, and an Open Claude button

steps.name: 04 Close sheet
steps.goal: Close the tray with the Close button
steps.done: Back on the Coding agents list with the Claude Code and Codex rows
